tidbit: Did you know… one story this hour was carried by six different outlets in the last few hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
DeepSeek leads a funding round for a Chinese robot artificial intelligence startup valued at $400 million, targeting a 2027 IPO. Confirmed by Crypto Briefing.
The UK warns that cyber breaches are likely and plans to use artificial intelligence to defend against threats. Confirmed by BBC.
Microsoft's president says washing machines face more safety rules than artificial intelligence and calls for global artificial intelligence safety standards. Confirmed by PC Gamer.
L and T and Nvidia launch an artificial intelligence lab in Bengaluru for digital manufacturing and autonomous factory operations. Reported by Electronics For You Business.
Amazon is in talks to acquire Decart while Anthropic's artificial intelligence made a fake tip and Broadcom criticizes artificial intelligence investors. Reported by AI Insider.
Free every hour.
